original.question: Indawo yegumbi lika-billie igumbi lokulala elingunxande ngu-360 amafuti ayisikwele. Uma ubude begumbi bungu-3 iyadi, umjikelezo wegumbi ngamafuti ubuphi?
original.answer:
Ubude begumbi bungu-3 iyadi * (3 amafuti / 1 iyadi) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 amafuti.
Ububanzi begumbi bungu-360 amafuti ayisikwele / 9 amafuti = <<360/9=40>>40 amafuti.
Umjikelezo wegumbi ngu-2(40+9) = 98 amafuti
